edges.reason: from parameter flows into the _transfer validation and balance logic.
to parameter flows into the _transfer validation, limit and fee logic.
amount parameter flows into the _transfer validation and fee logic.
amount is forwarded from _transfer into _tokenTransfer.
msg.sender is used as the transfer origin in transfer().
msg.sender is used as spender in the transferFrom allowance update.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer in transferFrom.
transfer() invokes _transfer.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer.
_transfer delegates balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapBack, which performs unchecked low-level ETH sends while the transfer is still executing.
swapBack performs an unchecked low-level value call to marketingAddress before addLiquidity, enabling reentrancy.
ETH is sent to the owner-mutable marketingAddress, which may be an attacker-controlled contract that reenters.
devAddress receives ethForDev via a low-level call in swapBack.
treasuryAddress receives ethForTreasury via a low-level call in swapBack.
ethForMarketing is the value attached to the low-level marketing call.
The boolean returned by the marketing call is stored in the unchecked success variable.
withdrawStuckETH performs an unchecked low-level value call to msg.sender.
The entire contract balance is sent to caller-controlled msg.sender, enabling reentrancy and arbitrary code execution.
_transfer compares amount against maxTransactionAmount for anti-whale limits.
_transfer computes balanceOf(to) + amount <= maxWalletAmount, an additive comparison sensitive to reflection-rate arithmetic.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs[from]/[to] to classify buys and sells.
_transfer reads inSwapAndLiquify to avoid nested swap logic.
_transfer reads _liquidityTokensToSwap when computing totalTokensToSwap.
_transfer reads _teamTokensToSwap when computing totalTokensToSwap.
_transfer compares block.number with tradingActiveBlock for sniper fee tiers.
swapBack runs under the lockTheSwap modifier that writes inSwapAndLiquify.
swapBack calls addLiquidity for the reserved liquidity tokens.
swapBack calls swapTokensForETH to convert tokens into ETH.
swapTokensForETH executes the external router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
addLiquidity executes the external router addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline, making liquidity timing miner-influenced.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making swap timing miner-influenced.
forceSwapBack invokes swapBack and therefore the unchecked ETH distribution calls.
forceSwapBack emits OwnerForcedSwapBack(block.timestamp), a timestamp dependency.
launch calls addLiquidity with the contract token/ETH balances.
launch is onlyOwner and reassigns ownership via transferOwnership(_owner), gating privileged setup.
setMarketingAddress writes the marketingAddress state variable used as an ETH sink in swapBack.
_takeLiquidity increments _liquidityTokensToSwap with the per-switch liquidity share.
_takeLiquidity increments _teamTokensToSwap with the per-switch team share.
tLiquidity parameter is used in the token/reflection accounting of _takeLiquidity.
currentRate converts tLiquidity into reflection liquidity credited to the contract.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rOwned of excluded accounts to derive the reflection supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tOwned of excluded accounts to derive the token supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal when supply accounting becomes inconsistent.
contractTokenBalance = balanceOf(address(this)) is computed inside _transfer.
overMinimumTokenBalance gates the swapBack call inside _transfer.
totalTokensToSwap is used for the ETH distribution ratio inside swapBack.
tokensForLiquidity is diverted to addLiquidity inside swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is passed as tokenAmount to swapTokensForETH.
tokenAmount parameter controls the amount sent to the router swap.
path array [token, WETH] is supplied to the router swap call.
takeFee boolean selects fee removal before dispatch in _tokenTransfer.
addLiquidity (unsafe router call) is reached from swapBack during value distribution.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a local parameter consumed only by the core _transfer routine.
to is a local parameter consumed only by the core _transfer routine.
amount is a local parameter consumed by _transfer and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
recipient is a local parameter consumed by the core transferFrom entry point.
contractTokenBalance is a local snapshot nested inside _transfer.
overMinimumTokenBalance is a local boolean nested inside _transfer.
takeFee is a local boolean that only controls fee handling in _tokenTransfer.
totalTokensToSwap is a local accumulation used solely by swapBack.
tokensForLiquidity is a local computation used solely by swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is a local amount handed to the swapTokensForETH helper.
ethForMarketing is the local value attached to the unsafe marketing low-level call.
success stores the unchecked result of the low-level value calls, including withdrawStuckETH.
tokenAmount is a local parameter consumed by the swapTokensForETH helper.
path is a local array built and consumed by swapTokensForETH.
tLiquidity is a local parameter consumed only by _takeLiquidity.
currentRate is a local rate value consumed only by _takeLiquidity.
